title: Recorded behavior comparison
responsibility: Aligns headless results from selected evidence and distinguishes byte differences from established behavior changes.

inputs.name: explorerBehavior.evidence
inputs.description: Host-selected before/after evidence and scenario context.

outputs.name: behaviorKinds
outputs.description: Output, assertions and trace capture kinds; benchmark captures are excluded.

outputs.name: behaviorSummary
outputs.description: Summary and optional reason, with unknown taking precedence over unread byte differences. Empty rows are unknown; all unchanged rows are unchanged; other resolved differences are changed.

outputs.name: explorerBehavior
outputs.description: Union of result rows matched by scenario, state, evidence and kind, with after-side order first and before-only rows afterward. Unusable captures become absent cells and unknown changes. Equal hashes are provisionally unchanged; different hashes only differ until read. No before side yields not-compared, while missing records or incompatibility prevent comparison.
